# OpenCode Plugin

A Bun-based TypeScript plugin for [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai).

## Getting Started

```bash
# Install dependencies
bun install

# Run in development mode (with watch)
bun run dev

# Run tests
bun test

# Type check
bun run typecheck

# Build
bun run build
```

## Project Structure

```
opencode-plugin/
├── src/
│   └── index.ts        # Plugin entry point
├── package.json
├── tsconfig.json
└── README.md
```
